solution:
**Calculation:**

Average of 2 wheeler = (4200 + 5350 + 5800 + 5250 + 5500)/5 = 5220

Average of 4 wheeler = (1080 + 1200 + 1340 + 1550 + 1130)/5 = 1260

Difference = 5220 - 1260 = 3960
